mapper.select: SELECT id, group_code, group_name, description, enabled FROM code_group ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, group_code, group_name, description, enabled FROM code_group WHERE LOWER(group_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(group_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(description) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(enabled) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_group (group_code, group_name, description, enabled) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{enabled})
